SPECIMEN
A. Right upper lobe lung, image-guided core biopsy

FINAL DIAGNOSIS
Lung, right upper lobe, core biopsy:
Pulmonary adenocarcinoma.

MICROSCOPIC DESCRIPTION
Core fragments contain infiltrating malignant glands with focal
papillary architecture, nuclear enlargement, and conspicuous nucleoli.
Focal necrosis is present. No definitive squamous differentiation
is identified in the sampled tissue.

IMMUNOHISTOCHEMISTRY
TTF-1: Positive in tumor nuclei.
Napsin A: Positive in tumor cytoplasm.
p40: Negative in tumor cells.
The findings support pulmonary adenocarcinoma.

CLINICAL HISTORY
Known EGFR-mutated lung adenocarcinoma. Repeat biopsy for
molecular reassessment; correlate with prior therapy and testing.

GROSS DESCRIPTION
Four tan-white cores, 0.3-0.9 cm in length and up to 0.1 cm
in diameter; submitted entirely in cassette A1.
Fixative: 10% neutral buffered formalin.

MOLECULAR TESTING
Block A1 selected; estimated viable tumor cellularity 40%.
Targeted DNA sequencing reported separately as MP32-006381.
The diagnosis is based on this biopsy; pathologic stage is not assigned.

SPECIMEN INFORMATION

Diagnosis: Pulmonary adenocarcinoma
Material: Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded core biopsy
Specimen part: A | Block: A1
Tumor cellularity: 40% | Macrodissection: Performed

MOLECULAR RESULTS
EGFR p.L858R detected; variant allele fraction 28%.
EGFR p.T790M detected; variant allele fraction 12%.

VARIANT DETAILS
Gene  Transcript       Exon  Coding change   Protein change
EGFR  NM_005228.5       21    c.2573T>G       p.L858R
EGFR  NM_005228.5       20    c.2369C>T       p.T790M

INTERPRETATION
Two EGFR substitutions are detected. Correlate with prior molecular
testing and treatment history. The phase relationship of the two
variants is not determined. Tumor-only testing does not establish
whether a variant is somatic or germline.

QUALITY METRICS
DNA input: 42 ng | Mean target depth: 1540x
L858R locus depth: 1640x | T790M locus depth: 1240x
Target bases at >=250x coverage: 99.4%
All listed quality metrics are simulated for this illustration.

METHOD
Illustrative targeted DNA sequencing of EGFR exons 18-21.
Single-nucleotide variants and small insertions/deletions assessed.
Illustrative reporting threshold: 5% variant allele fraction.
No RNA fusion or copy-number assessment is included.

LIMITATIONS
Low tumor content, sampling, and variants below the reporting
threshold may limit detection. A negative result would not exclude
alterations outside the interrogated regions. No paired normal
sample was analyzed. Assay specifications are illustrative only.
